conviction_note: Small net negative. The H1 plan needs Q2 operating profit of 438m yen, the company's own internal Q2 plan is about 385m, and Q1 came in 53m under its internal plan. So H1 probably lands a few percent short. The one consensus number (ordinary profit 2,000m) sits above the company's 1,914m, so holding the FY plan is mildly disappointing and a cut is the tail risk. About 3.7% of shares sit in margin longs with no margin short side to squeeze. Against that, Q2 on its own should roughly double year on year against a 206m base, the bad news has been out since the -11% Q1 reaction, and the stock is back near its post-Q1 low at PER 12 and a 3% yield. The H1 shortfall is visible from the last 短信, so p_up 46 on a 6.0 scale gives -0.48. That is close to the findings' sum of -0.5 by coincidence, not by fitting.
bar: Company H1 (3-8月) plan: sales 7,185m / OP 877m / ordinary 856m, unchanged since 2026-04-14 and restated 2026-07-15 (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260715/140120260715594254.pdf). Internal Q1 plan OP 492m, so implied Q2 plan about 385m (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260715/140120260715594278.pdf, slides 5 and 9). FY market number: IFIS consensus ordinary profit 2,000m against company 1,914m (https://kabuyoho.jp/report?bcode=6224), one source and apparently thin coverage (no rating, no target), so the FY bar is single-sourced and the findings that depend on it are capped small. print_vs_bar is my estimate of H1 OP (about 825m) against the 877m plan.
positioning_check: JPX short register: 0.0%, no disclosed position at or above 0.5%, unchanged (baseline, as of 2026-10-14, https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html). 信用: margin long 490.6k shares, margin short 0 (the name is 買建のみ, not 貸借, so margin shorting is impossible and the 信用倍率 reads '－'), steady at 489-496k over 2026-09-11 to 10-09 (https://kabutan.jp/stock/?code=6224). That is about 3.7% of 13.33m shares outstanding and about 27 sessions of the 20-day median turnover (20.2m yen / 1,137 yen is about 17.8k shares a day). Founder vehicles hold about 35% (YSホールディングス 20.3%, エムワイエフ 14.9%), so the margin long is a larger share of the free float. No skew exists. A crowded leveraged retail long with no short fuel: a miss has sellers and a beat has no squeeze.

findings.finding: Q1 operating profit of 439m yen was 89.3% of the company's internal Q1 plan of 492m. The H1 plan of 877m therefore needs Q2 OP of 438m against an implied internal Q2 plan of about 385m and last year's Q2 of 206m. H1 OP most likely lands about 3-10% below plan (my estimate about 825m), with environment-energy recovery costs and robot-SI timing slips the swing items.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2025-10-15 Q2 print: H1 OP 904m was 1.4% below the revised H1 plan, FY held, Q2 standalone OP fell 52% YoY, and the stock fell 19.33% the next session. 2026-07-15 Q1 print: OP 37% down YoY and below internal plan, stock -11.45% (kabutan k202510150030, k202607150066; baseline history).
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced. The internal Q1 attainment (89.3%) was printed on a slide, the stock fell 11% on it and has not recovered (1,371 to 1,135). What may not be priced is the arithmetic that even meeting the internal Q2 plan leaves H1 about 6% short. kabutan's headline frames Q1 as 49.9% progress 'in line with the 3-year average 51.4%', which reads as on track. If the market had priced an H1 miss it would also be pricing the FY risk, and the price has drifted back to the July low instead.
findings.independence: Same document family as finding 2 (Q1 短信/説明資料). kabutan's progress framing (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=6224&b=k202607150066) points the other way, toward 'on track'.

findings.finding: FY plan (OP 1,965m, ordinary 1,914m) is 22.3-22.4% achieved after Q1, against 37.1% at the same point last year and an implied H2 OP of 1,088m (last year's H2 was 1,059m). The one consensus figure (IFIS ordinary 2,000m) sits 4.5% above the company plan. A held FY plan is mildly below the street, and a FY cut at this print is the tail risk.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: FY2026.02 was revised twice (2025-07-15 and 2025-12-18). The July 2025 upward revision came with a +26% reaction. The October 2025 print held FY and fell 19%. FY2024.02's initial OP plan of 1,364m was missed (actual 1,270m) (kabutan finance page).
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: the stock trades at PER 12 on the company plan, low for a 27% ROE name, which already discounts some risk to the plan. The consensus is one apparently thin source (no rating or target shown), so a hold may not register as a miss at all. Sized small because the bar is single-sourced. The asymmetry is that nobody has pre-released a cut (no 業績予想の修正 on TDnet through 2026-10-14), so a cut would be news and a hold would be roughly neutral.
findings.independence: Progress figures come from the same Q1 説明資料 as finding 1 (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260715/140120260715594278.pdf). The consensus figure is independent (kabuyoho/IFIS).

findings.finding: Margin long of 490.6k shares (about 3.7% of shares outstanding, about 27 days of median turnover) has sat unchanged since early September, with zero margin short possible (買建のみ). A disappointing print meets leveraged retail sellers and nothing on the short side to absorb them.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: After the 2026-07-15 Q1 print the stock fell 11.45% and kept falling for two weeks on heavy volume (263k shares on 07-16 against about 20k normal), consistent with leveraged long liquidation (Yahoo chart).
findings.why_not_priced: The baseline's margin_ratio is null because the ratio is undefined (no shorts), so priced_lean_pct carries no margin-overhang term. The balance is not in the lean the market-neutral comparison uses. If it were priced, the stock would not hold at the July low with the overhang intact.
findings.independence: Daily volume series (https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/6224.T?range=6mo&interval=1d) gives the turnover denominator. Otherwise none.

findings.finding: Q2 standalone OP should roughly double year on year: the plan implies 385-438m against 206m in 6-8月 2025, when environment-energy profit was 12m. The kabutan-style headline at 15:30 will likely read a large Q2 profit increase even if H1 is a few percent short of plan, which is a 悪材料出尽くし setup after the -11% Q1 reaction.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2025's standalone collapse (-52% ordinary) coincided with the -19% reaction, so this line has moved the stock before, in the other direction.
findings.why_not_priced: The price sits at the post-Q1 low (1,135 against 1,090-1,150 since July) as if the weak Q1 trend were extrapolating. The easy Q2 comparison is visible only by subtracting Q1 from the H1 plan on a slide, not in any headline number the market has seen.
findings.independence: Same document as finding 1. The two readings are of one plan, and both can be true at once (strong YoY, short of plan). Last year's Q2 base is confirmed independently on kabutan (https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=6224).

findings.finding: M&A and order flow since Q1: environment-energy orders of about 7.6億 (8/19), acquisitions of 機電 (8/24), トーカイコンベア (8/25) and ナンヨートレイディング (9/14, closing 10/1), a new Growth M&A company, and ¥1.1bn of five-year bank borrowing on 9/18 for acquisition funding. The company calls each one 軽微 for this year.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The M&A announcements produced a 5-day run from 1,136 to 1,253 (8/24-8/31), fully given back by October (Yahoo chart; kabutan 2026-08-26 article).
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced: the run-up was given back. What remains is whether the H1 presentation adds acquired revenue or order backlog to H2, which no outside number shows. The financing buys acquisitions of profitable small firms (Nanyo OP 70m on 335m sales), not distress: net debt/EBITDA was 0.85x at Q1.

findings.finding: 光通信 filed three successive increases to its large holding (変更報告書 No.2-4 on 2026-05-01, 05-27 and 07-24), the last one in the week after the Q1 sell-off, so a known value buyer has been adding at these prices.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No observed reaction on this line.
findings.why_not_priced: Public since July. Its relevance is as a bid under a disappointment, which the price has not had to test since July.

outside_window.finding: Contribution from the three acquisitions (Nanyo closes 2026-10-01; 機電 and トーカイコンベア consolidated from H2) and the Vietnam plant start-up land in H2 numbers, not in this print.

baseline_tension: The baseline lean is +0.16 (run-up -3.2%, no shorts) and my findings net slightly negative, mostly on visible arithmetic. The strongest positive the release could carry is a roughly doubled Q2 standalone profit plus a held FY plan and dividend after an 11% drawdown already taken (filed at +0.5). I looked for a buyback signal and found none. Per LESSONS rule 1, the H1 shortfall is computable from the last 短信, so it moves p_up toward 50 and its own size down.
lessons_applied: Rule 1 (a negative resting on a 進捗率 anyone can compute from the last 短信): H1-shortfall finding cut from -0.8 to -0.4, and p_up moved from 44 to 46.

Rule 2 (negatives outnumbering positives): wrote down the strongest positive the release could carry and filed it as a new finding: Q2 standalone profit roughly doubling YoY, a 悪材料出尽くし setup, +0.5. Checked for a buyback and found none.

Left standing: the FY-vs-consensus finding (-0.6), because a FY cut is something the release could ADD, which rule 1 exempts. Margin-long positioning (-0.5), the M&A finding (+0.3) and 光通信 (+0.2) were unchanged. abs_move_pct unchanged at 6.0.
